name: send_review_invitation
description: An invitation to a SEND review meeting (SEN support review or EHC plan annual review), sent to contacts with parental responsibility.
subject: Invitation to {pupil_name}'s {review_type}
body: We would like to invite you to {pupil_name}'s {review_type}.

At the meeting we will look at how {pupil_name} is getting on, the support in place and what we should all work on next. Your views, and {pupil_name}'s, matter - please bring anything you would like to share.
Please let the school office know whether you can attend.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.when: The date and time of the meeting
placeholders.sender_name: The member of staff sending it
